features.name: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) core: RAG, agentic workflows, vector DB integration

history.detail: Introduced as Technology Preview (distribution ~0.2.22-class). Remote inference, built-in embeddings, vector DB operations, TrustyAI safety/eval integration.
PostgreSQL Operator became a hard requirement. Distribution 0.3.5. HA configuration and custom embeddings added as TP sub-features.
Distribution 0.4.2. Multi-architecture Operator support became default. OpenAI-compatible citation annotations added as TP.
Llama Stack Operator remains Technology Preview in the formal 3.4 support matrix (0.9.0, TP on x86_64/Arm/Power, unavailable IBM Z).

Renamed to OGX at 3.5 EA1 (breaking manual migration). At 3.5 GA: Supported Configurations lists OGX Operator 0.11.0 / OGX 1.1.2 as GA on x86_64/Arm/Power, while the OGX product guide labels the OpenShift AI integration Technology Preview. Responses API is GA; most others TP/DP.
Default and only metadata store option (3.0-3.1).
Deprecated for production use specifically. PostgreSQL required for production-grade environments.
Unchanged through 3.5 GA: SQLite remains available only for local dev/testing; PostgreSQL required for production.
Introduced via the TrustyAI Operator, built on IBM Research's fms-guardrails-orchestrator project.
Core described as generally available through 3.4. The 3.4 safety guide labels it legacy, to be deprecated in a future release.
Directly confirmed in 3.5 release notes Chapter 5: deprecated, remains functional, will be removed in a future release. NeMo Guardrails is now the single recommended framework.
Removal targeted for Q4 2026 (RHAI 3.6).
Introduced as Technology Preview.
Remained TP, documentation compares it against FMS-Guardrails as a parallel competing path.
Fully supported. Adds standalone /v1/guardrails/checks endpoint, OpenAI-compatible /v1/models/ endpoint, regex-based rails, multi-replica scaling.
Core GA on x86_64 and IBM Power. Release notes announce IBM Z support but current matrix does not list it on s390x -- source conflict.
Introduced as Developer Preview.
Promoted to Technology Preview.
Fully supported. MLflow Operator became a managed component in the DataScienceCluster CR.
Scope substantially widened: embedded into AI Pipelines, workbenches, Kubeflow SDK/Trainer, AI Hub. Age-based trace archival to S3. EvalCard generation.
Evaluation Stack UI: Technology Preview. Underlying REST orchestration control plane: Developer Preview.

history.status: GA in release notes / TP in matrix
history.detail: 3.5 GA release notes state EvalHub is GA with full support. Current Supported Configurations matrix lists EvalHub 0.3.0 as TP on x86_64, unavailable elsewhere. This registry follows the matrix.
New GA EvalHub UI with Evaluation Gallery; GA adapters for Inspect AI, Garak, LightEval, RAGAS, GuideLLM, IBM CLEAR.

features.name: Kubeflow Trainer v2 (replacing Training Operator v1)

history.detail: Kubeflow Training Operator v1 marked deprecated; transition to Trainer v2 announced.
Kubeflow Trainer v2 introduced as Technology Preview.
GA on x86_64 and Arm; unavailable on IBM Power and IBM Z.
Remains GA on x86_64/Arm. Training Hub fine-tuning algorithms (SFT, OSFT, LoRA, GRPO) can run on Ray clusters.

features.name: Kueue (embedded component -> Red Hat build of Kueue Operator)

history.detail: Embedded Kueue component marked deprecated.
Embedded component removed; replaced by standalone Red Hat build of Kueue Operator.
New at 3.5 GA: administrators can self-manage ClusterQueues/LocalQueues via a boolean flag, disabled by default.
CodeFlare Operator marked deprecated.
CodeFlare Operator removed outright; functionality folded into KubeRay Operator.
Live source conflict: 3.5 release notes say upgraded to 1.6.x; matrix lists KubeRay 1.4.2 (GA x86_64/Arm, TP Power, unavailable Z).
Marked deprecated.
Architecture consolidated onto KServe RawDeployment mode. Unmigrated workloads return HTTP 503.
Retired from the supported 3.x serving architecture. New at 3.5 GA: canary rollout support for RawDeployment InferenceServices.
Marked deprecated.
Architecture consolidated onto KServe RawDeployment mode.
Retired from the supported 3.x serving architecture.
Introduced as Developer Preview.
GA on x86_64 and aarch64 (0.7.1). Requires OpenShift 4.20+; unavailable on IBM Power/Z.

GA extended to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and CoreWeave Kubernetes Service (CKS); Amazon EKS added as TP. Istio is now the supported gateway. Tokenizer now runs as dedicated external service requiring amd64 node.

features.name: Distributed Inference with llm-d: priority-based flow control

history.detail: Technology Preview flow control for Distributed Inference with llm-d.

Breaking change on promotion: TP (3.4) -> GA (3.5) while changing API group (inference.networking.x-k8s.io -> llm-d.ai), metrics prefix, and saturation-detector config path. Anyone who configured flow control during 3.4 TP has mandatory remediation work.
Core GA on x86_64/Arm, TP on IBM Power, unavailable on IBM Z.
Adds SparkApplication batch materialization engine and bidirectional workbench/Feature Store visibility. Does not promote the Power implementation beyond TP.
Added IBM Power (ppc64le) and IBM Z (s390x) architecture support.
New capability: OCI-compliant storage layer, converting registered models to ModelCar OCI images.
Catalog enrichment: Safety and Security Insights tab, cold-start load time and minimum vRAM metrics, validated tool-calling arguments panel.
Kubernetes-native operator for deploying/managing MCP servers. Defaults to Removed in DataScienceCluster; must be explicitly set to Managed.
MCP Lifecycle promoted TP -> GA targeted in RHAI 3.6.
Technology Preview (EA2 also used Developer Preview wording).
Remains TP on x86_64 and IBM Power, unavailable on Arm and IBM Z. Adds model-insight curves/backtesting, TP AutoGluon serving runtime.
AutoML promoted TP -> GA targeted for RHAI 3.6.
Technology Preview (EA2 also used Developer Preview wording).
Remains TP on x86_64; unavailable on Arm/Power/Z. Adds CPU-only deployment, multilingual support, structural contextualization.
AutoRAG promoted TP -> GA targeted for RHAI 3.6.

features.name: Models-as-a-Service (MaaS) core: access model and token mechanism

history.detail: Introduced as Technology Preview. Tier-based governance; MaaS-issued service-account-backed token.
Reached GA. Tiers replaced by subscriptions and dedicated CRs (MaaSSubscription, MaaSAuthPolicy, MaaSModelRef). NOT backward compatible with 3.3 -- amber TP-to-GA migration break.
GA core expanded: external OIDC authentication reaches GA, OpenAI-compatible body-based model routing reaches GA, Subscriptions+Authorization pages merge into one MaaS governance page.
Classic ServingRuntime + InferenceService path. Core supported runtime.
Remains GA. Foundational vLLM GA status does not extend to every vLLM-adjacent delivery path (MaaS deployment, LLMInferenceService, fast-release images are each separate maturity surfaces).

features.name: Gateway API and Red Hat Connectivity Link (RHCL)

history.detail: Gateway API replacing OpenShift Routes, kube-rbac-proxy replacing oauth-proxy -- core architecture shift. Custom workbench images built against oauth-proxy require rebuilding.
Direct OIDC auth via GatewayConfig CR reaches GA. RHCL included in Red Hat AI SKUs for MaaS use cases only; not included for other components.
New known issue on RHCL 1.4.0/1.4.1: rate limiting silently stops working on batch gateway deployments (RHOAIENG-76586); recommend RHCL 1.3.5 for batch gateways.
